line: Welcome home, good hunter. What is it you desire?
sourceNote: English segment (0:00-8:09) of 'Bloodborne All Dialogues: Doll (Multi-language)' compilation by manfightdragon; trimmed with ffmpeg at exact word timestamps located via local whisper.cpp transcription.

line: Ah, welcome home, good hunter. I must've drifted off. What is it you desire?
sourceNote: Alternate/longer 'waking up' delivery of the welcome-home line, later in the same compilation.

line: Very well. Let the echoes become your strength. Let me stand close. Now shut your eyes.
Farewell, good hunter. May you find your worth in the waking world.

sourceNote: Bonus atmospheric clip: the Doll's hum, also uploaded standalone at https://youtu.be/nEvHa9UQPR0.

line: Grant us eyes. Grant us eyes.
sourceNote: English segment (0:00-4:22) of 'Bloodborne Micolash, Host of the Nightmare's dialogues' compilation by manfightdragon.

line: Our eyes are yet to open. Fear the old blood, by the gods, fear it, Lawrence.
sourceNote: English segment (0:00-1:51) of 'Bloodborne Provost Willem's dialogues' compilation by manfightdragon.

line: Aha! You must be the new hunter. Welcome to the hunter's dream. This will be your home for now.
sourceNote: Opening greeting line, English segment (0:00-11:37) of 'Bloodborne Old Hunter Gehrman's dialogues' compilation by manfightdragon.
